name: glass_orbs
description: translucent glass orbs strung along glowing lace: every disc of a circle packing a domed bubble with a hard highlight and a bright rim, lit softly from inside, the lace showing through, faint ripple rings round the set's crossings

reference.made_with: an escape-time render signed 'exoteric.roach.org' (Ultra Fractal by its look), 2560x1600

reuses: the bubble trap on its unit lattice (`center` [0.5, 0.5], `radius` 0.11, `escaped`, `largest` 0.12, `smallest` 0.006): orbs of every size along the set
a `light` at `period` 2 on the bubble's `height` (specular 1.0): each orb a glossy dome, over a translucent tint (a `normal` glow at 0.6) and an inner glow from its middle
the inverted `height` as a sharp glow: the bright rim
a circle stroke about the critical value (`on_c`, radius 0.5, `steps` 8): faint ripple rings
the inverted distance by rank for the ground, a `de` halo and hair for the lace
the tone pass, at the reference's median and p10
notes: Item 074 (round one), triage group (7): orbits (this file), time-delay and wallhaven-0wl9zq as palette entries of this stack (satin_orbs, cobalt_orbs). One escape loop reaches it: the orbs are the bubble trap's entries and the ripple a stroke trap, both functions of one orbit.

Nearest modes: gilded_orbs (jewel orbs set in gold filigree, opaque lit bands) and 042's discarded plastic_orbs (four opaque packings, 1/5). What differs: the orbs are glass, a thin tint with a rim and a hard highlight through which the lace still reads, small (`largest` 0.12) so they string along the set as beads rather than packing the frame.
Readings: bare (no orbs: the headline), no_ripples, glassy (a thinner tint, a brighter middle, a finer rim), large (`radius` 0.2, `largest` 0.22), deep (an opaque tint, a fainter lace).

Round one (picker style_ornate_rings_orbs_r1): formulations at julia-mandelbrot_2fd9890d and julia-multibrot3_5a1c473f (a dense-lace seat where few orbs escape); ten locations kept by eye from forty `style scout --seed 74` seats. Tone: the first stack (ground at gamma 3.2, a lavender-white lace) missed orbits' balance at every seat (p90 0.63 to 0.78 vs 0.508, black 0.25 to 0.39 vs 0.156), so it was re-tuned as step 5 says: the ground at gamma 0.5 over a map whose dark end is navy, not black, the lace read at 0.5 and 0.65 of a map whose top is a pale periwinkle; then 6 of the 10 shown hold, the rest missing p90 by 0.01 to 0.02. Seams: an orb whose entry passes `largest` leaves a sharp-edged fragment of the next at a few seats (bubble `fade` would thin it, but faded shapes need additive layers). Cost (074, box loaded, an upper bound): 73 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at the parity seat (18 s native); the parity run's native side draws on three threads, so WebAssembly costs about 1.3 times native thread-time: about 95 s at its formulation seat (12 s native at six threads).

Explorer cost (080, `style cost`, read beside other Node workers: an upper bound): 167 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at its deepest kept seat (julia-mandelbrot_2fd9890d, maxiter 13,907), under the 5-minute bar.
